name: brief
description: Writes and validates the standing brief a session works from: intent, definition of done, one proof per criterion, the behaviour that already exists, and the boundaries. Refuses an incomplete brief, a credential and an absolute path. Compatible with skill: 'brief' (.agents/skills/brief/SKILL.md).

job.description: Job id; the brief is written to .runs/<job>/brief.json and brief.md.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the job.

intent.description: What the human can do once this work is finished.

done.description: Acceptance criteria, one checkable statement per entry.

proof.description: One proof per criterion: the command, log line or file that closes it.

existing.description: The behaviour that already exists and must not change.

boundaries.description: What this must not do, and what it must not touch.
